annotations.title: Hold a campaign's launch posts until a store product goes active

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Holds a builder campaign's launch posts (by default the launch, product, sale, last-chance, thank-you and follow-up phases) until the brand's own Mercatus store reports the product (productId, from the synced catalog) active. Then each held post goes out at its planned time, or shortly after the release when that time has passed — the posts GO LIVE, but only those with an approved review. If the product is already active they release at once. Arm it before or after book_campaign. Needs `publish`; Agency plan. Confirm with the user first.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/campaigns/builder/{id}/release-on-product.)

brandId.description: Brand to act in. A brand-bound key acts in its own brand (another brandId is 403); an account-wide key defaults to the owner's active brand.

connectionId.description: The Mercatus connection to listen on. Only needed when the brand has more than one.

phases.description: The arc phases to hold. Default (configured): launch, product, mid_sale, last_chance, thank_you, follow_up. A post about another product of the campaign is never held.

productId.description: The Mercatus product id, as in the brand's synced catalog.

name: release_campaign_on_product
title: Hold a campaign's launch posts until a store product goes active
